title: A Ledger for the Atlas
author: Gideon Villalobos
blurb: Ansel Iversen, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
